messages:
emma_csm: FYI  we have ~14 onboarding tenants with delayed embeddings and occasional 5xxs from the connector between 11:05-11:28 UTC today. Flagging 2 accounts as renewal-risk. Need a crisp external blurb + validation steps and an office hours invite.

riley_cs: Acknowledged. Do we know whether this affected customers using our webhook ingestion vs SDK? That affects the troubleshooting steps. :mag: 

incident_bot: [incident created] INC-2026-0621-11 | severity=sev2 | owner=@chad_sre | tags=[webhook,embeddings,onboard]

chad_sre: Quick triage: routing rule misconfig in our webhook router caused a subset of POSTs to be forwarded to an older embeddings worker pool that had an intermittent auth bug. Retries compounded under the recent onboarding surge, producing partial failures and delayed replays.

priya_infra: Metrics: webhook_forward_errors spiked to 9.8% (baseline 0.1%). embedding_retry_rate jumped x12. After we rolled the router fix at 3932101205, forward_errors dropped to 0.3%. Replay jobs started at 3932101250 and are ~72% complete.

emma_csm: Draft for customers (short): ```Hello  we experienced partial onboarding interruptions for some accounts between 11:05-11:28 UTC on 2026-06-21 affecting embed generation for new documents. Cause: a routing configuration error forwarded certain webhook payloads to an outdated worker pool with an auth regression; this caused some writes to fail and required replay. What we did: fixed the router config, patched the worker auth, and reprocessed affected batches. Status: replays are ~72% complete and most tenants are processing normally. Next steps: final replays expected within 3-5 hours; office hours at 19:00 UTC today to review impact and next steps (link). Compensation: impacted high-touch customers will be offered a targeted onboarding credit; CS will follow up with eligible accounts. We apologize for the disruption.  Redwood Inference Team```

riley_cs: Looks good. Can we add a tiny validation checklist for webhook users: (1) verify recent embed counts via index stats, (2) re-run a sample webhook POST to confirm success, (3) check ingest response codes in their logs. Include this curl snippet: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"doc":"test"}' https://webhook.redwood.example/v1/ingest -i```

chad_sre: From SRE: patch and router rollback deployed at 3932101205; added a short-term alert for webhook_forward_errors > 1% (created 3932101280). Also added a safety check in the router to prevent forwarding to deprecated pools.

priya_infra: Postmortem summary for CS: root cause = misrouted webhook traffic due to config drift + an uncovered auth regression in an older worker pool; fix = router config correction + worker auth patch + replay idempotency enhancements. Full postmortem ETA EOD 2026-06-21.

emma_csm: Please send the external note once SRE thumbs. I'll handle the two renewal-risk accounts and coordinate credits. We'll capture customer feedback in office hours and add asks to the postmortem.

riley_cs: Sending now to affected list, cc @emma_csm. Office hours link added. I'll post an internal-only follow-up with the exact account list.

incident_bot: [update] INC-2026-0621-11 | mitigation=router_fix,auth_patch | replay_progress=72% | status=monitoring

chad_sre: Monitoring replay backlog and will DM CS if any tenant's replays slip beyond 6 hours.

priya_infra: I'll attach routing diffs and an example auth failure log to the postmortem for CS reference.

emma_csm: Thanks team 44d closing loop for CS prep.
